# Music Directory

Place your romantic background music file here.

## Instructions

1. Add your audio file (e.g., `romantic-piano.mp3`)
2. Update the `musicFile` path in `src/config.ts` to match your filename

## Recommended

- Use royalty-free music
- Keep file size under 5MB for fast loading
- Use MP3 format for best browser compatibility
- Duration: 2-4 minutes (will loop)

## Sources for Royalty-Free Music

- YouTube Audio Library
- Free Music Archive
- Pixabay Music
- Bensound
